elements.name: young man seen from behind in centre
old boxy cream-coloured country bus seen from side
bundles tied on bus roof rack
low houses with rusty corrugated tin roofs

wrong_setting: The scene reads as a suburban American or Australian street: weatherboard bungalows with tiled roofs, porches, paved kerbs, bollards, manicured lawns and a parked car, with no bus at all instead of an Ethiopian highland town.
notes: Regenerate the background: put the side of an old cream country bus, door open with bundles on the roof rack, directly in front of him, and replace the suburban bungalows and paved kerbs with mud-walled houses under rusty tin roofs on red-brown dusty ground in high midday sun.
